description: This PHP class defines a controller (VacancyListRSSController) responsible for generating an RSS feed of published job vacancies in the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It constructs the RSS XML dynamically, including channel info and vacancy items, by fetching vacancy data and utilizing URL generation and localization services.

classes.name: VacancyListRSSController
classes.description: Controller responsible for generating an RSS feed of active vacancies, implementing response handling and XML document creation.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the HTTP request, sets content type to XML, and returns the generated RSS feed wrapped in a Response object.

methods.name: generateRSSFeed
methods.description: Constructs the RSS XML document with channel info and vacancy items based on published vacancies.

methods.name: getPublishedVacancies
methods.description: Retrieves the list of published vacancies from the vacancy service.
